title: "I can't believe this is Legal"... What is a "Side Letter"
description:
Side letters—also known as side agreements—might seem like a clever way to close a deal, but they can come with serious risks. In this video, we break down what side letters actually are, why some buyers and sellers use them, and the legal and financial pitfalls they can create. These off-the-record agreements often don’t go to the bank or lender, which can lead to major issues down the road if things go sideways.

We’ll cover when side letters are used, what makes them risky, and how they can impact your financing, due diligence, or even violate loan covenants. If you’re buying or selling a business and someone suggests a side agreement, watch this first—you’ll want to know exactly what you’re getting into before you sign anything that doesn’t make it into the main contract.
